items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Buddy Bolden; you come there and you can hear this music.

ctx.x: They become alive. And that's what we try to do. Charlie passed away a month or so ago, and I'm playing...

There's an old abandoned firehouse I've been trying to get, right in the middle of the Black neighborhood that I was born and raised in, and I want to use that as a little opera house, something like that Nashville thing that they have for opera [sic: Grand Old Opry], have a little place where young Blacks or any Black can come in and hear traditional music, and keep the tradition. It means that the music of Armstrong and Oliver and Noone and Bunk Johnson and Buddy Bolden; you come there and you can hear this…
